title: I got lucid in a mall world dream and tried to kidnap a dream character

meta.final_emotion: freaked out; woke with sharp sensation in middle of head that faded over a few minutes
meta.author_theory: Mentions possibility of shared dreams/other realm; feeling of being watched; idea of Mall World as a real place in a different realm.

locations.location_name: giant mall atrium (open atrium type of space)

qualities.raw_description: very large open atrium type of space; like a giant mall atrium with retail stores all around the lower level, water fountain in the middle and very tall glass skylight ceiling; atrium space was very tall

interactions.description: Gained lucidity; paused to reaffirm dreaming/lucidity and establish confidence in the scene; lucidity felt different because dreamer was still going through the motions of whatever role they were playing as if not lucid.

After breaking 'character role', picked up the closest dream character and carried them away; other dream characters reacted with shock (gasped, wide eyes, hands over open mouths). One character chased the dreamer; dreamer put the carried person down; small shoving match with the chaser who was very upset.

entities_involved.description: about two dozen other people; reacted with gasps, wide eyes, hands over open mouths
closest dream character; was picked up and carried away
one character chased after me; very upset; got into a small shoving match

interactions.description: Dreamer turned and started walking away; every step became harder like an invisible force was holding them back; struggled to take ~10 more steps; became paralyzed standing and unable to move anything; then woke up in bed.

entities_involved.description: invisible force holding me back; pulled out of a dream (not first time)

interactions.transaction_blocker: invisible force; paralysis in standing position

interactions.description: Felt there were a lot of eyes on them; speculated there could have been observation balconies overhead (dreamer did not look up).

extraction.extraction_notes: Only one explicit location (mall atrium). "Observation balconies" are mentioned as a possibility but not confirmed/seen; recorded as an observation/uncertain detail in raw text. Dreamer role is described as 'whatever role I was playing' but not specified.
